title: Mixed Event — close game/OFFLINE — Episode2 Player Has Entered!

meta.Event Outline: Nene finds out there will be a gaming tournament taking place at an arcade, and decides to participate in hopes of winning the grand prize. But just around the same time, Toya is also thinking about participating...

rows.Line: The day of the gaming tournament
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This is where the gaming tournament's gonna take place?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's bigger than I expected...
I sorta just assumed that it was a small place based on that flyer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And it's all underground. It feels like a secret base!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it... M-Miku?!
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe☆ This sounded like fun so I decided to join you! Mind if I stick around to watch for a bit?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
We can play together☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure that's gonna be possible...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But we can just have you hide once more people show up, so why don't you stay with us until then?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yay☆ Thanks!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Still, they have so many games here!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know this one!
You dance while staying in rhythm with the music☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried it a while back and got up to the highest level!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, really...? That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What do you usually play, Nene?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I usually play shooters and...
Well, games that involve playing against others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shooters?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They're games where you use a gun.
There should be some around here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
What's this doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What is it?
Is this game really rare or something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Black Galaxy Soldier's a foreign title and really popular among gamers, but there aren't supposed to be that many of these machines in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I really wasn't expecting to find it here...
I thought the only arcade with it was the one by the station...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Would it be okay if I took a quick look at it...? I really wanna see what the controller's like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, is that gun the controller?
Cool!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanna watch while you use it, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In that case...
se_event_cyber_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(The buttons are so easy to press...
And the reticle's aligned perfectly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As far as I can see, even the older components seem clean and well-maintained... I'm starting to like this place. And it's really close by...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
That gave me a good picture.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Just after holding it?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, all I did was see if this would be easier to use compared to one at this other arcade...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But despite having a game that you weren't expecting to see here, there aren't that many people here at this arcade.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
You'd think it'd be more crowded since it's so clean with so much available.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Why do you think that is?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Could it be the location?
It might be hard to spot since it's underground.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, I'm really glad this place exists.
Less people means I can focus more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already time?!
We need to register for the competition.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku!
You're gonna have to hide for a bit here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Okay, have fun!
I'll be cheering for you from your pocket☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Excuse me... Is this where we register for the gaming tournament?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Oh, hello...!
Does this mean you're interested?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Alright, if you don't mind filling out this form for me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I can take care of that!
Here, here and done!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, it's filled out!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm so glad that you've decided to enter. Unfortunately for us, we haven't gotten many customers...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is kind of unfortunate...
I mean, this arcade's so big.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe being underground really is making this place hard to find.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: That could be a factor, but some other reasons also come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Other reasons?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: So, my grandfather used to be the manager of this arcade before he passed away, and my father, who didn't know much about video games, decided to take over...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Since he did, the games weren't maintained properly and it became difficult to bring in new titles.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We had to start weighing our options after our sales began to plummet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This was your grandfather's arcade...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: We even reached the point of talking about shuttering this place for good, but I spoke out against it because this place means quite a lot to me and proposed that we try to start over...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: And I decided to hold a gaming tournament as a way to promote this arcade in the hopes that it'd attract more customers.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: This grand reopening is supposed to mark a new dawn for us! My hope is that you really get to enjoy yourselves today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We will! And I'll do my best to make this tournament really exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I should also do my best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can tell they take good care of all their machines just based on how the controllers look and feel...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If we want this place to stay in business, we'll need to do our best today to make this tournament a good one.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa, there's way more people here now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, there are... But I'm seeing a lot of elderly people and women who seem to be homemakers... Not exactly what you'd call gamers...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the manager said that they tried reaching out to everyone in the neighborhood for this tournament!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The more the merrier☆
It's more fun that way, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Right...
At the same time, I'm getting kinda nervous about playing in front of all these people...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for gathering here today! We will now be kicking off our Funtastic Gaming Tournament!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, it's starting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Let's get started by introducing the four teams that will be participating today!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Everybody, come on up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, we have to go up on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(There's less people than I thought...
I might be okay if the crowd stays around this size.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Alright, here are our teams.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: First up... The Wonderhoy Button Mashers!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wonderhoy Button Mashers...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, hey!
That's us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hang on, Emu, when did you come up with this team name?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's what I wrote on that form during registration for the part that said, “Team Name.” And I came up with this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's cute, right?! Video games are all about pressing lots of buttons, right☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure “cute” is the right word... It seems kinda dorky, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Our next team is We're The Best, followed by Muscles Are Everything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, everyone chose goofy team names...)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
And finally, we have...
Willow & Cloud!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Willow & Cloud?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do you think it means?
It's a little different from the other team names, so what kind of people do you think are...?
We're looking forward to competing today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that voice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That looks like the split-personality guy and... Aoyagi?! What are they doing here...?!)
